svg.title: Two graphs of the diving board model, d squared x by d t squared plus 2 d x by d t plus 26 x equals 0, starting at x equals 10 at rest. Left: displacement x in centimetres against time t from 0 to 5 seconds, an oscillation that starts at 10 and dies away towards 0. Right: the phase portrait with x across and velocity y equals d x by d t up; the trajectory starts at the point 10, 0 and spirals clockwise into the origin.
